summary: RUNDA 1.2 VERIFIED end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 11/12 PASS, 1 skip (see below) in /app/backend/tests/test_runda12_backend.py. C2: [data-testid=more-export] visible for admin in /more, tap triggers GET /api/export → 200 AND GET /api/export/last → 200, toast 'Eksport danych' displayed. B1: PASSWORD_MIN=14 enforced (422 + polish message) in ALL 4 paths — /auth/register, /auth/change-password, /users/{id}/reset-password, /auth/password-reset/confirm (token). B2: token reset confirmed sets must_change_password=True (verified via /users listing AND login response). C1: /admin/health returns unique_index_present=true; uniqueness partial-index/app-guard covers 'wstrzymany' status — element A forced to status 'wstrzymany' via direct DB write, second element with same kod_norm → 409; after archiving A the same kod is reusable → 201. REGRESJA: DELETE /elements, /reports, /users still soft-archive (verified in-line + full E4 suite already 32/32 passed in iter10). Deprecated props detected: shadow* style props and pointerEvents prop — see react_native_issues.

minor.issue: ElementUpdateIn model does not expose 'status' field, so 'wstrzymany' is unreachable via public API. It only appears in ACTIVE_ELEMENT_STATUSES enum but no code path can set it. Not blocking (unique-index test uses direct DB write to prove coverage), but a status-transition endpoint (or allowing status in ElementUpdateIn with an admin/foreman guard + audit) would help admins pause an element from the UI.

Archived (soft-deleted) user login returns 403 instead of 401. Semantically ambiguous — 403 implies 'authenticated but forbidden' while user is not authenticated. Suggest 401 with 'Konto nieaktywne' for consistency. Not blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Search codebase for pointerEvents={...} and move to style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking but will break in future RN versions.
Repeated console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow (RN 0.76+).

action_items: Migrate pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents (grep /app/frontend for `pointerEvents=`).
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow (StyleSheet definitions).
Optional: consider returning 401 (instead of 403) on login attempt for archived users for semantic consistency.
Optional: if UI needs to pause an element (status='wstrzymany'), expose a small POST /elements/{id}/pause endpoint or add `status` field to ElementUpdateIn with admin/foreman guard + audit log.
